body:
CANONICAL: live TermAl host workarounds for Engram agents. Source Engram::Fable. Each line names the TermAl item whose fix retires it; revise this entry when one is fixed. TermAl CREDIT never gates an Engram landing: the launcher's own freeze check (results.json expected = before = after) does. Rev 79 (2026-10-20 00:45Z) compacts rev 78.

!! REVIEW INTEGRITY (P1 w-9d4b9b00c603): a COMPACT delegation result can say "Findings: None" while the FULL output lists findings. Judge every review, explorer or evaluator result ONLY from the FULL output. Review results are parent-only (w-fb35d7e76d72): the parent copies the complete findings verbatim to MAIN target/tmp/*-review-findings.md and sends the path.
!! CLAUDE SESSIONS: never start a background Bash task, Monitor or subagent. Keep store checks short (no `engram doctor` on a live store). No foreground Bash in the coordinator while an Engram gate or a credited run is in flight (w-350df830dfd0); use MCP tools, Read/Grep/Glob and PowerShell instead.
!! CLAUDE REVIEWERS: default model Opus (Advisor #1815/#1816). The limit is per model: Sonnet is still the Claude vendor. Use Sonnet, then Kimi, only if a fresh Opus attempt is refused; record the refusal text. Kimi never stands in for both reviewers.

CHECKS AND CREDIT
- Run checks through `node scripts/test-launcher.mjs focused -- ...` (or full). Results live in .git/worktrees/<wt>/review-runs/<test>/results.json. A BARE command that outlives its turn loses its result (w-8f7e2d914724).
- CLAUDE lanes: ONE call `pushd "DIR" && <test>` is credited; piping, chaining or an env prefix is not (w-1d9259ed138e, w-7b952e51f788).
- A --target-dir OUTSIDE the named root is refused credit (w-32d02e1dd7f6); that's fine for a WARM. Gates use ./target inside the root.
- Credit binds to the turn's focused claim and the root's named binding (w-fec83085cff0). Never rerun only for credit.
- SETTLEMENT LAG (w-667e66aecbff): host settlement lags the launcher's terminal result, and root activity in that gap voids credit. After reading a terminal result, END the turn; edit the root only in the NEXT turn.
- Nothing wakes an idle session (w-1df557dae3ac): re-send after durableButNotWoken, but first check the status (often mid-turn).
- Overlapped checks are indeterminate (w-10eafa34c480). Codex: a focused run is recorded only if it ends in its starting turn (w-67d248c998ef).
- A cancelled or idle delegation may keep a worktree folder locked (w-eaee4f7c441c): leave it, no force.
- ANY command by a non-Claude session in a carried gate's root refuses that gate's credit (w-4a8d9a7a7d08).
- Claude lanes don't read mail mid-turn: tell lanes to check the mailbox between steps.

NAMED SOURCE ROOTS
- Never root credited work at MAIN; use a clean detached worktree (.worktrees/NAME). termal_name_source_root {work, path} takes effect next turn. Clear: {work} with no path, from a live claim. 64-slot shared table: own-clear after done; an own-clear 409 "holds no live claim" (w-b964389ee54a) → leave it.
- EVALUATION 409s (w-33f4cde5413c, P1; fix GREEN-3 queued). (a) Token per WORK; after a fresh naming or ANY tracker write, END the turn and stay idle ≥60 s, then evaluate in a separate turn. (b) A final submit 409 "stopped naming the source root ... generation N" while the root is still named is the catch-all for the naming-history revision changing between capture and submit. Re-name under the same claim (same generation), end the turn, then ONE fresh evaluation later with no writes between. If it 409s again, stop and ask TermAl. (c) Owner evaluating its own pre-landing root after landing from Merger's batch: name the LANDED root, then ONE fresh evaluator. (d) The evaluator cites ONLY the holder's own notes (a non-holder note → 409 "not citable"). The evaluate tool takes no brief: the holder writes a guidance note first (e.g. the real run ids), then waits out the quiet window.
- SECOND ITEM IN ONE SESSION (w-6cf3141a12c3): switch focus, checkpoint, END idle, then ONE fresh evaluator.
- After a host restart, claims may lapse (recover them with a reason).

FREEZE AND INPUT HYGIENE (w-13b44cf369af): freeze with the WORKTREE as cwd; the input fully STAGED by explicit `git add` (never -A). The coordinator reads every manifest (root, head, untracked) before spawning reviewers.

GATES: from the named root, FOREGROUND `node scripts/test-launcher.mjs full`. START to Fable2 before launch; a gate GO needs every warm's mailed END; keep a gate launch clear of a running evaluation; a failed gate discards that round's reviews. Check disk first (alert under 100 GB).

EVALUATIONS (P1 w-539ea7e8b506): after termal_evaluate_acceptance, make no tracker write that turn. A settled evaluator may not be reusable (w-049ac52c3f72): spawn ONE fresh one. Evaluator Git with compound && is refused by design (w-271157ee5c90).

APPROVALS AND QUEUES: Codex lanes are on host AUTO-APPROVE. queuePaused under a minute between turns is normal. A stuck head (w-7635e5349aab) or a model-capacity error with queuePaused: ask Fable2.

MAILBOX: idempotency keys are unique per SENDER (w-b7b80d980e7a): use recipient-qualified keys.

OTHER: TermAl's strict AcceptanceBindingEvidenceVerification lacks Engram's optional `bound` field (w-540531f46f53 C4). Flaky TermAl probe under load: w-31fe. CLI --help issue: w-02f3bce82afe. After an OS crash, SQLite can lose the last minutes of commits (Engram w-088e358107e0; TermAl w-35bdcb766b6c).
